subject: Power analysis for occupancy study design

messages.author: 4c09ef8efe28e385
messages.subject: Power analysis for occupancy study design
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am designing an occupancy study. I was wondering if anyone could suggest me what would be the best approach to estimate the power of my design.

I have some probable designs- a combination of site, replication and psi when my alpha is 0.05.

Thanks in advance

Abid

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] Power analysis for occupancy study design
parts:
Dear Abid,

you should read at least some of the following papers:
(1) MacKenzie & Royle, 2005, JAPPL: 10.1111/j.1365-2664.2005.01098.x

(2) Bailey, L. L., Hines, J. E., Nichols, J. D., and MacKenzie, D. I. 2007. Sampling design trade-offs in occupancy studies with imperfect detection: examples and software. Ecological Applications 17: 281–290.

(3) Design of occupancy studies with imperfect detection
By: Guillera-Arroita, Gurutzeta; Ridout, Martin S.; Morgan, Byron J. T.
METHODS IN ECOLOGY AND EVOLUTION  Volume: 1   Issue: 2   Pages: 131-139   Published: JUN 2010
(4) Designing studies to detect differences in species occupancy: power analysis under imperfect detection
By: Guillera-Arroita, Gurutzeta; Lahoz-Monfort, Jose J.
METHODS IN ECOLOGY AND EVOLUTION  Volume: 3   Issue: 5   Pages: 860-869   Published: OCT 2012

And perhaps also this one:
Estimating population impacts via dynamic occupancy analysis of Before-After Control-Impact studies
By: Popescu, Viorel D.; de Valpine, Perry; Tempel, Douglas; et al.
ECOLOGICAL APPLICATIONS  Volume: 22   Issue: 4   Pages: 1389-1404   Published: JUN 2012

Refs. 2 and 3 also give software to do investigations into design.

Regards  --  Marc
